name: Alchemical Hydra

mechanics.name: Style Alternation
mechanics.description: It switches between magic and ranged every three attacks, and the head it raises tells you which is coming. In the final phase it switches every single attack.
mechanics.counterplay: Count its attacks and swap your overhead on the third. In the last phase, swap every time.

mechanics.name: Poison Splatters
mechanics.description: It throws blobs of poison onto and around where you are standing, and each one settles into a pool that keeps hurting.
mechanics.counterplay: Run north on its fourth attack and keep off the pools.

mechanics.name: Lightning
mechanics.description: Four currents of lightning start in the corners of the chamber and converge on wherever you are standing. Getting caught binds you in place.
mechanics.counterplay: Run west along the north wall as it converges, or pin it in the north-west corner.

mechanics.name: Flame Walls
mechanics.description: It walks to the middle of the chamber, stuns you, breathes a wall of fire across the tiles around it, then sends fire chasing after you.
mechanics.counterplay: Walk, do not run, in a straight line. The fire trails behind you as long as you keep a steady pace.

mechanics.name: Enrage Phase
mechanics.description: Its carapace turns grey, it stops needing a vent, and it attacks faster and far harder while still alternating styles.
mechanics.counterplay: Swap your overhead on every attack and keep dodging poison as you did in the first phase.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). All eight Alchemical Hydra npc ids are in npcIds, because the boss changes npc id as it changes phase rather than spawning a new npc, and an npc transform has to be tracked as the boss for its animations to keep matching (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). The phase-to-npc mapping is read off each npc's own standing animation against the HYDRA_STAGE_n_READY gamevals: 8615 is stage 1 (ready 8233), 8617 and 8619 stage 2 (ready 8240), 8618 and 8620 stage 3 (ready 8247), 8621 and 8622 stage 4 (ready 8254). 8616 has no standing animation and is presumably a transition state. Animations are the four complete HYDRA_STAGE_n_ATTACK_{RANGED,MAGIC,SPECIAL} sets, all unambiguous gameval names. Projectiles HYDRABOSS_MAGIC_PROJ 1662, HYDRABOSS_RANGED_PROJ 1663 and HYDRABOSS_POOLS_PROJ 1644 are curated because each carries an explicit _PROJ suffix in Jagex's own name, which is the bar for a projectile trigger in this wave; the sibling HYDRABOSS_POOLS_SPLASH 1645, the ten POOLS_LANDING ids and the ten POOLS_LANDED ids are graphics and are deliberately left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). THE CHEMICAL VENTS ARE A KNOWN MISSING MECHANIC. They are the counterplay to the whole fight, but they are scenery the player interacts with rather than anything the npc does, so there is no animation, npc or projectile to hang them on. THE STYLE ALTERNATION MECHANIC DETECTS ON ALL EIGHT ATTACK ANIMATIONS ACROSS ALL FOUR PHASES, which means it unlocks on the boss's first ordinary attack. That is intended: it is the one mechanic that is true in every phase, and its phase label is deliberately absent for the same reason. Zoom and shiftY are FitZoom output at the shipped 291x140 box plus the standard 10% margin; none of the five needed the zoom correction the flying and oversized models in the God Wars batch did, though the flame-walls preview at zoom 4345 is the widest fit in the file, because the stage 3 special sweeps the model much further than its own idle footprint. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Alchemical Hydra', matching 'name'. FEEDBACK PASS 2026-08-07 (Andrew reviewed every boss in game): Mechanic "Enraged Phase" is now "Enrage Phase" and its tag "Enraged" is now "Enrage", per the tag normalisation recorded on araxxor.json.
